Name: A Fair Bargain with Raphael
Author: pikacyu
Description:
A Fair Bargain with Raphael / 与拉斐尔的一桩公平交易

背景设定 / Background
邪念毁约杀死拉斐尔后，墨菲斯托将他复活。但重生出了差错——他没有回到深水城、博德之门或任何他应该在的地方，而是落在了星露谷。

这是一个可攻略的独立 NPC 模组。他有完整的心事件线，但“可攻略”这件事本身是有条件的，下面会写清楚。

本模组是基于《博德之门3》的同人二创作品。拉斐尔及相关设定版权归 Larian Studios 所有。本模组免费发布，非官方作品。

The Dark Urge broke a contract and killed Raphael; Mephistopheles then revived him. But something went wrong with the resurrection—he did not return to Waterdeep, Baldur’s Gate, or anywhere he was supposed to be. He landed in Stardew Valley.

This is a standalone, romanceable NPC mod. He has a full heart event storyline, but the romance itself comes with a condition. That part is explained below.

This is a fan-made mod based on Baldur’s Gate 3. The character Raphael and all related content remain the property of Larian Studios. This mod is released for free and is not an official Larian product.

前置需求 / Requirements
以下两项缺一不可：

Content Patcher（框架，没有它模组无法加载）

Portraiture（N 网尾号 999，高清肖像框架）——没有它会直接报错。

本模组的肖像包是单独压缩包，需解压到 Mods/Portraiture/Portraits。用法与 Portraiture 默认设置一致，游戏中对话时按 P 切换肖像。

关于 SVE：本模组兼容 Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)。SVE 不是必需前置；未安装 SVE 时，模组仍可正常运行，SVE 专属礼物和内容不会出现。

There are two mandatory requirements:

Content Patcher (framework; the mod will not load without it)

Portraiture (Nexus mod ID 999, HD portrait framework)—the mod will throw errors without it.

The portrait pack for this mod is a separate archive and must be unzipped into Mods/Portraiture/Portraits. It works exactly like Portraiture’s default setup: press P during a dialogue in-game to switch portraits.

Note on SVE: This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE). SVE is not a required dependency; the mod still runs fine without it, and SVE-exclusive gifts and content will simply not appear.

安装与卸载 / Installation
把下载的模组本体压缩包解压到星露谷的 Mods 文件夹里；肖像包单独解压到 Mods/Portraiture/Portraits。卸载时把对应的模组文件夹整个删掉即可；如果单独安装了肖像包，也把对应的肖像文件删掉。

旧存档理论上可以装，不保证稳定性——测试都是在新建存档上做的。多人模式未测试，不保证稳定性。

Unzip the main mod archive into your Stardew Valley Mods folder, and unzip the portrait pack separately into Mods/Portraiture/Portraits. To uninstall, delete the mod’s folder from Mods; if you installed the portrait pack separately, remove those portrait files as well.

Existing saves should work in theory, but stability isn’t guaranteed—all testing was done on new saves. Multiplayer has not been tested; stability is not guaranteed.

解锁与关系机制 / How the Romance Unlocks

这部分可能和大多数星露谷 NPC 不太一样，所以单独写。

拉斐尔不会在开局就出现。游戏前七天他不会出现在任何地方。从春 8（游戏第 8 天）开始，在晴天的上午 9:00 到下午 5:00 之间前往森林，会触发初次见面剧情。剧情播放后的次日，他才会正式出现在游戏里。

他出现之后，也没有默认的可约会状态（即 datable 标记）。送花束、约会、节日跳舞和结婚，在他身上不会按常规时间线解锁。你需要先把他的好感度推到 10 心，并触发 10 心事件。10 心剧情播放后的次日，可约会状态才会出现，这时才能开始攻略。

换句话说：不触发 10 心事件，即使好感度达到 10 心，也不能送花；10 心事件播放前，节日上也不能邀请他跳舞。这两点都是设定，不是 bug。

This works differently from most Stardew NPCs, so it gets its own section.

Raphael does not appear at the start of the game. For the first seven days, he can’t be found anywhere. Starting from Spring 8 (the 8th day of the game), go to the Forest on a sunny day between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM to trigger his first meeting event. He won’t officially appear in the world until the day after that event plays.

Even after he appears, he does not start with datable/single status (the datable flag). Bouquets, dating, festival dancing, and marriage will not unlock on the usual timeline. You need to reach 10 hearts with him and trigger his 10-heart event first. The datable flag appears the day after that event plays, and only then can the romance begin.

In other words: without the 10-heart event, you cannot give him a bouquet even at 10 hearts; likewise, before the 10-heart event plays, you cannot ask him to dance at festivals. Both are intentional, not bugs.

关于这段关系 / On the Nature of This Romance
农夫可以与他结婚，但这段婚姻的本质是一桩交易——拉斐尔接受的是这桩交易，而不是感情。他对农夫没有爱意，台词和反应会遵循这个前提。用他本人的逻辑来概括就是：“拉斐尔只爱拉斐尔。”

如果你在找的是一个婚后甜腻、会改口说“你是我唯一”的角色，他不是。他的主线不会往那个方向走。台词细节可能会在后续更新中调整，但这条关系逻辑是固定的。

The farmer can marry him, but the marriage is a bargain—Raphael accepted the bargain, not the affection. He does not love the farmer, and his dialogue and reactions follow that premise. To put it in his own terms: “Raphael only loves Raphael.”

If you’re looking for a saccharine post-marriage arc where he does a full 180 and starts calling the farmer his one and only, that is not the character this mod writes. The main line does not move in that direction. Individual lines may be adjusted in future updates, but the relationship logic stays fixed.

下载前须知 / Before You Download

没有露骨描写，但婚后少量台词含轻微暗示。

语言：游戏内提供中英双语。英文文本由 DeepSeek 翻译，部分措辞可能不够自然，建议以中文原文为准。

模组文件夹里的 README.txt 按攻略形式整理了他的礼物喜好、心事件触发条件、行程、节日到场安排和电影院偏好，下载后看一眼即可。送出部分礼物或观看部分电影时，他会触发专属台词反应，具体内容留给你在游戏里自己发现。

No explicit content, but a small number of post-marriage lines carry mild innuendo.

Language: The in-game text is available in both Chinese and English. The English text was translated with DeepSeek; some phrasing may read unnaturally in places, so please refer to the Chinese original as the authoritative version.

The README.txt inside the mod folder is a walkthrough-style reference covering his gift preferences, heart event conditions, schedule, festival attendance, and his preferences for the Movies—give it a quick look after downloading. Some gifts and movies trigger exclusive dialogue reactions; those are left for you to discover in-game.

翻译与转载 / Translations & Permissions

本模组自带的英文文本由 DeepSeek 翻译，部分措辞可能不够自然，因此尤其欢迎人工翻译或改进版本。

翻译只要满足以下条件即可：翻译的是文本，而不是把整个模组重新打包发布；不是完全机翻；开始之前先联系我一下，说一声就好。

除翻译外，请不要未经沟通重新上传或转载这个模组。N 网后台的 Permissions 标签页里对应选项也会这样设置。

The English text included in this mod was translated by DeepSeek and may read unnaturally in places, so human translations or improvements are especially welcome.

The only requirements are that you translate the text rather than repack or reupload the entire mod, that the translation is not raw machine output, and that you send me a message first so I know it is happening.

Other than translations, please do not reupload or repost the mod without talking to me first. The Permissions tab on the mod’s Nexus page will be set accordingly.

AI 使用披露 / AI Disclosure
按照 N 网 2026 年 AI 政策，本模组的 AI 使用范围如下：

肖像：由 SeaArt（Seedream 5.0 Flash）生成，经 Qwen 精修。属于 AI 生成图像。

代码：部分由 DeepSeek 辅助生成；设计、整合与修正由人类主导。所有 AI 辅助代码在发布前均经过测试和迭代。

游戏内文本：中文原文由我本人撰写。DeepSeek 仅用于校对和极个别措辞润色，没有参与剧情、台词或角色塑造。

i18n 英文翻译：游戏内文本的英文版本完全由 DeepSeek 翻译，未经人工逐句校对。

README.txt：由 DeepSeek 辅助起草，内容基于我提供的模组信息；英文版由 DeepSeek 翻译。

介绍页说明：中文描述由 DeepSeek 辅助起草；英文版由 DeepSeek 翻译。

In line with Nexus’ 2026 AI policy, here is the scope of AI use in this mod:

Portraits: Generated with SeaArt (Seedream 5.0 Flash) and refined with Qwen. These are AI-generated images.

Code: Partially generated with DeepSeek’s assistance; design, integration, and correction were human-led. All AI-assisted code was tested and refined before release.

In-game text: The Chinese original was written by me. DeepSeek was used only for proofreading and polishing a small number of word choices; it did not write the story, dialogue, or characterization.

i18n English translation: The English version of the in-game text was translated entirely by DeepSeek, without line-by-line human proofreading.

README.txt: Drafted with DeepSeek’s assistance based on mod information I provided; the English version was translated by DeepSeek.

Mod page description: The Chinese description was drafted with DeepSeek’s assistance; the English version was translated by DeepSeek.

关于作者 / A Note from the Author
这是我在 N 网发布的第一个模组。内容比较基础，一些地方可能还不够顺，我还在边做边学。如果遇到无法触发的事件、读起来别扭的台词，或者别的什么不对劲的地方，在评论区说一声就行，后续会慢慢修。

This is my first mod on Nexus. It is fairly basic; some parts may not read as smoothly as they should, and I am still learning as I go. If you run into an event that will not trigger, a line that reads oddly, or anything else that feels off, just leave a comment and I will work on it.
